note: YC hint confirmed: the YC directory entry 'Shuttle' (Summer 2020 batch, Inactive, London) lists https://www.shuttle.dev as its site, same company. Shuttle raised a $6M seed round in October 2025 from Y Combinator, Global Founders Capital, and angels (Thomas Dohmke, Calvin French-Owen), per its own blog and The SaaS News. Despite this raise, the company (per the provider card's own caveats) subsequently ceased operations: Community-tier data was deleted from early 2026, Pro projects stopped Jan 16 2026, and its GitHub repo (shuttle-hq/shuttle) was archived; the marketing homepage remains online as a static shell with no shutdown banner. Buyers should treat Shuttle as discontinued despite the recent funding.
